title: Timecode
description: Rational timecode primitives. tech-spec §3 fixes this convention with high blast radius: timecode is a `{num, den}` timebase plus integer tick counts — NEVER float seconds. Float seconds accumulate error across cut/concat arithmetic, and PRD REQ-019 ('no generated EDL may reference media outside the source range') is only decidable with exact integers. Audio uses the same shape with `timebase = {num: 1, den: sampleRate}`, so sample counts and frame counts share one representation.

Timebase.title: Timebase
Timebase.description: Seconds per tick, as an exact rational: `seconds = ticks * num / den`. Matches FFmpeg's `time_base` convention. Example: 30000/1001 fps video has `{num: 1001, den: 30000}`.

MediaTime.title: MediaTime
MediaTime.description: An exact instant or duration: `ticks` counted in `timebase`.

SourceRange.title: SourceRange
SourceRange.description: A half-open range [startTicks, endTicks) into one source asset, in one timebase. Half-open so adjacent ranges abut without overlapping by one tick. `range-check.ts` is the SINGLE implementation that validates these against the asset's preflighted duration (Phase 2 task 10); `cutdown index` runs it over every generated Moment and Phase 3's `validate` reuses it for EDL ranges — the mechanism behind the 'zero invalid source ranges' Phase 0 exit criterion.

assetId.description: ULID of the SourceAsset this range indexes into.

endTicks.description: Exclusive end. `endTicks > startTicks` is enforced by range-check.ts, not by JSON Schema — draft 2020-12 cannot express a cross-property inequality, and tech-spec §3 forbids `if/then/else`.

ContentHash.title: ContentHash
ContentHash.description: Content address for an artefact or media file (PRD REQ-005). sha256 is the only algorithm at Phase 0; the field is present so a future algorithm is an additive change.

Ulid.title: Ulid
Ulid.description: Object identity (tech-spec §3: 'object IDs are ULIDs'). Crockford base32, 26 chars, lexicographically sortable by creation time.
